<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Hm? Looks like there’s not enough room to play. <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,29)>Think you
can make some space?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Parece que não há espaço suficiente para brincar. <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,29)>Pensar em ti.
Conseguem arranjar espaço?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>I...don’t think this place is the right fit for me. Somewhere
else would be better.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Eu... não acho que este lugar é o melhor para mim.
Se não fosse, seria melhor.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>Hey, thanks. This is nice. I’m actually pretty full right now,
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>but I appreciate the thought.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>Obrigado. Isto é bom. Na verdade, estou muito cheio agora,
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>Mas agradeço a ideia.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Where’s a good spot for me to live?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Onde é um bom lugar para eu viver?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Is this...my new home?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Esta é a minha nova casa?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>Heh, thanks. OK, get ready...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,16)>Who would you say is heavier, <$cdef(27)> or me?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>Está bem, prepara-te...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,16)>Quem dirias que é mais pesado? <$cdef(27)> Ou eu?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,7)>You interested in that, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,7)>está interessado nisso? <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Cool. You got something to trade for it?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>tem alguma coisa para trocar por ela?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Guess I got ahead of myself...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Acho que me precipitei...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,9)>Thanks. Glad we both got something good out of this.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,9)>Ainda bem que ambos conseguimos algo de bom.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Not interested after all? Well, if you decide you do actually
want it, just say the word.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Afinal de contas, não está interessado?
Se quiseres, é só dizeres.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,9)>Thanks for a great trade.
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh hey, look at that—I’m out of stock. I’ll go pick up some
more stuff for next time.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,9)>Obrigado por uma grande troca.
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh hey, olhe para isso — Estou sem estoque. Eu vou pegar alguns
Mais coisas para a próxima vez.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,1)>I’ll be doing some <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(12)>s at the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1325)> today.
<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,13)>You should stop by if you’ve got time.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,1)>Eu estarei fazendo alguns <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(12)>s na <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1325)> Hoje.
<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,13)>Você deve parar por se você tiver tempo.

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)>I’m stoked everything sold out today. <$pkcry;0(1,1)>!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>See you next time, <$cdef(27)>.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)>Eu estou animado com tudo esgotado hoje. <$pkcry;0(1,1)>!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>Até à próxima. <$cdef(27)>.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)>Hmmm... This is pretty interesting.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)>Isto é muito interessante.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>You got me some food? Heh, thanks. Looks tasty.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Obrigado, parece delicioso.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>I always feel so hungry in the morning.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Guess that’s why breakfast is so important.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Sinto sempre tanta fome de manhã.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Acho que é por isso que o café da manhã é tão importante.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>. Sun’s pretty bright today,
huh?
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)>Not gonna outshine us, though.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>Olá. <$cdef(27)>. O sol é muito brilhante hoje,
Não é?
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)>Mas não nos vai ofuscar.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>... The sky goes on forever.
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,29)>You ever wonder where it ends?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>O céu continua para sempre.
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,29)>Alguma vez te perguntaste onde é que acaba?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,14)>I like spending time with folks, but being alone can be
pretty relaxing too.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I want to appreciate those quiet moments as they happen.
Gazing up at the moon...or listening to the breeze...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,14)>Gosto de passar tempo com as pessoas, mas ficar sozinha pode ser
Muito relaxante também.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Quero apreciar esses momentos de silêncio enquanto acontecem.
Olhando para a lua... ou ouvindo a brisa...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>You ever try walking around without a destination in mind,
going wherever the wind takes you? It can be fun.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Maybe try it sometime, <$cdef(27)>.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Você nunca tentar andar por aí sem um destino em mente,
Vai para onde o vento te levar?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Talvez um dia. <$cdef(27)>.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Earlier, I thought I heard a little kid crying nearby.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>After anxiously searching the area, I realized <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,802)>it was just
the sound of my stomach rumbling... Whoops.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Mais cedo, pensei ter ouvido um miúdo a chorar por perto.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>Depois de revistar ansiosamente a área, percebi <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,802)>Foi só...
O som do meu estômago a tremer...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I’ve never had a friend like you before,
<$cdef(27)>.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,1)>You can transform into a human, build top-notch homes...
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,50)>I’m proud to call you a friend.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Eu nunca tive um amigo como você antes,
<$cdef(27)>.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,1)>Você pode se transformar em um humano, construir casas de topo...
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,50)>Tenho orgulho de chamá - lo de amigo.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>OK, guess I’ll call it a day.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Swing by again next time, yeah? I’ll be waiting.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Ok, acho que vou encerrar por hoje.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Passe novamente na próxima vez, sim? Estarei esperando.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Hey, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>. Wanna <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(12)></color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Olá. <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>Quero. <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(12)></color>?

dialogues.en:
<$cdef(27)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>’s at the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1325)>, apparently.
Go check it out, if you’re interested.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$cdef(27)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>É na <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1325)>Aparentemente.
Vá verificar, se você estiver interessado.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,6)>Up on the surface, the scenery is constantly changing. <$emotion(1,65)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,3)>The
sun rises and sets... The rain starts and stops...
<$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Underwater, things don’t tend to change as much. I find it
easier to relax, honestly.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,6)>Na superfície, o cenário está em constante mudança. <$emotion(1,65)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,3)>A
O sol nasce e põe-se... a chuva começa e pára...
<$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Debaixo d'água, as coisas não tendem a mudar tanto.
Mais fácil de relaxar, honestamente.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I see you’ve been busy watering lately. Keep it up—you’re
doing great.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Eu vejo que você tem estado ocupado regando ultimamente. Mantenha-o - você está
Está a ir muito bem.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, hey—you want this? Here, take it.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>- quer isto?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>I kinda like spending time with <$cdef(27)>.
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>They’re a good listener. Makes them easy to talk to.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>Eu gosto de passar tempo com <$cdef(27)>.
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>Eles são um bom ouvinte. Torna-os fáceis de conversar.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Hey, thanks again for
<$cdef(27)>
you
got me.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,5)> seriously great, and I’ll treasure always.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Ei, obrigado novamente por
<$cdef(27)>
você
Apanhei-me.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,5)> sério grande, e eu vou tesouro Sempre.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>I wonder what it’s like living in a human house... <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>I’d kinda
like to try it.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Hey, think you could make a house like the ones humans
live in, <$cdef(27)>?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Eu me pergunto como é viver em uma casa humana... <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Eu meio que
Gosto de experimentar.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Achas que pode fazer uma casa como a dos humanos?
viver em, <$cdef(27)>?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>My dreams get pretty weird after I stay up late.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Like the one where you transformed into a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>,
but I didn’t notice <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>until I took a bite out of you...
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)>Think I’ll turn in early tonight.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Os meus sonhos ficam estranhos depois de ficar acordado até tarde.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Como aquele em que você se transformou em um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>,
mas eu não notei <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>Até que te dei uma mordidela...
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)>Acho que vou dormir cedo esta noite.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,16)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,14)>*yawn* Morning already? The night flew by so fast...<$facial(1,1)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>I better head to bed. See you again some other night.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,16)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,14)>Já de manhã, a noite passou tão depressa...<$facial(1,1)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>É melhor eu ir para a cama.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,14)>When I fly, sometimes I notice a chill in the air or the faint
smell of flowers <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>and it’s like I feel the seasons changing.
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>I really love those moments.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,14)>Quando voo, às vezes percebo um frio no ar ou o desmaio.
cheiro de flores <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>e é como se eu sentisse as estações mudando.
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>Adoro esses momentos.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>My body’s really hard and solid, while yours is soft
and squishy...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Guess the world’s filled with all kinds of Pokémon, huh?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Some of them could be even more solid than me, or more
squishy than you.<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)> You think that’s likely?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Meu corpo é muito duro e sólido, enquanto o seu é macio
E fofinha...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Acho que o mundo está cheio de todos os tipos de Pokémon, hein?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Alguns deles podem ser ainda mais sólidos do que eu, ou mais.
Esfomeado que tu.<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)> Acha que isso é provável?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Way back in the day, a big Pokémon sneezed and I got
blown away.
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>It was pretty funny at the time, but <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>I’m more alert now
when I talk to anyone bigger than me.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Há muito tempo, um grande Pokémon espirrou e eu tive
Foi um espanto.
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Foi muito engraçado na altura, mas... <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Estou mais alerta agora
quando falo com alguém maior do que eu.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,48)>I’m not great with narrow spaces, given my size and all.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Wish I had some kinda device that could pick berries in
hard-to-reach spots... <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>That’d be a game changer.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,48)>Eu não sou grande com espaços estreitos, dado o meu tamanho e tudo.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Quem me dera ter algum tipo de dispositivo que pudesse apanhar bagas em
Pontos difíceis de alcançar... <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Isso seria uma mudança de jogo.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,666)>If I’m not paying attention, it’s easy to slip up and
accidentally burn a berry.
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,50)>Sometimes that makes it tastier, though.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,666)>Se eu não estou prestando atenção, é fácil deslizar e
Queimem acidentalmente uma baga.
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,50)>Mas às vezes isso torna-o mais saboroso.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>That moment you step in a puddle after it stops raining <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>is
kind of exciting, huh?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Aquele momento em que pisas numa poça depois de parar de chover <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>é
É excitante, não é?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Sometimes when I sneeze, I release electricity at the
same time.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>It’s way more satisfying than a regular sneeze.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Às vezes, quando espirro, libero electricidade no
Mesmo tempo.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>É muito mais satisfatório do que um espirro regular.

dialogues.en:
... ... ...
...<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,40)>I see!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Any second now, <$cdef(27)> will come and
talk
to me...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Wait, you already did. Darn... Guess it took me too long to
read your mind.
dialogues.pt_br:
... ... ...
...<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,40)>Estou a ver!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>A qualquer momento, <$cdef(27)> Virá e
falar
para mim...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Acho que levei muito tempo a pensar que a minha mãe era uma mulher.
Lê a tua mente.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>When it’s hot out, sometimes Pokémon huddle around
me to cool down.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)>I’m glad I can help, but they make those hot days even
hotter for me...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Quando está quente, às vezes Pokémon amontoa
Eu para me acalmar.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)>Fico feliz de poder ajudar, mas eles fazem aqueles dias quentes mesmo
